svg.title: News app: master architecture
svg.text: As of 2026-10-26 · flow: code → CI → registry → pull-based CD → local deploy
① Your Mac — code (3 git repos)
compose · gateway · CD scripts · roadmap (edit here)
Each service: own repo, own Dockerfile, own tests,
② GitHub — Actions CI (.github/workflows/ci.yml, same in each service repo)
Trigger: every push (any branch) + manual "Run workflow" · ~1.5 min · bump on main only
needs: test → no image is pushed unless every test passed
permissions: read-only by default; only the image job may write packages
concurrency: a newer push cancels the older run on the same branch
(temporary "Show github context" step kept for the YAML learning session)
Public (no secrets inside; pull needs no token)
SHA tags never move → deploy & rollback by SHA
④ Your Mac — Docker Desktop: local deploy (deploy clone ~/Deploy/news-app-platform, project "news-app")
deployed by the CD updater (only checks out origin/main commits) · ~8 s redeploy · only the gateway publishes ports, and only on 127.0.0.1
every 2 min · read-only (public repo, no credentials)
reverse proxy · the only entry point
backups/ on the host (git-ignored, outside volumes)
test-restore.sh → throwaway DB, compare row counts (PASS)
restore.sh → live DB (stop svc, restore in 1 transaction, start)
Secrets: dev default DB passwords locally; real ones only in an untracked .env on the machine that runs it — never in a repo or image.
Isolation: the gateway joins only "services"; each DB is on its own internal network with only its service, migrate and backup jobs (no internet, not resolvable by others).
⑤ Inside each service — clean architecture
⑥ Roadmap (CD done · next ones planned)
